final: WITH eligible AS (SELECT p.ID, COALESCE(p.SEX, '') AS SEX FROM Patient p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory x WHERE x.ID = p.ID AND x.`U-PRO` = '-')), patient_avgs AS (SELECT e.ID, e.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM eligible e JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID GROUP BY e.ID, e.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS average_alp_gpt_ratio FROM patient_avgs GROUP BY SEX
